title: Can you play GTA 6 on PC this November? Xbox clarifies cloud streaming plans ahead of launch
snippet: Xbox has denied a report claiming GTA 6 will be available to PC players through Xbox Cloud Gaming at launch on 19 November. The original report said Microsoft had secured exclusive streaming rights for the game, potentially giving PC users access to the game without an Xbox console.

title: Smart glasses privacy concerns grow: Norway, Australia, UK and US curb Meta Ray-Ban use
snippet: Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses are raising privacy concerns because they make it easier to capture photos, videos and audio without others knowing. Norway, Australia, the UK and the US are considering or enforcing restrictions on camera-equipped smart glasses in public and sensitive spaces.
